title: ze_only_up
description:
Follow the new ze maps here: 

ZE ONLY UP!
_____________________________________
Map from R1cko27 & Stepanof This map is ported to cs2.
The map has been improved, if you find any errors, please email me at Discord - r1cko27
_____________________________________
 
_____________________________________
There are 3 levels on the map
Level 1 and 2 to complete in a team
Level 3 - Speedrun Round
_____________________________________

 
_____________________________________
On this map, we have combined ZE and KZ. Moreover, to complete the map, you don't need to have great skills in both ZE and KZ. We have made the locations in such a way that it is clear and easy for a simple player to play on them. To activate triggers on the map, you need to have KZ skills
_____________________________________

 
_____________________________________

There are many interesting locations on the map, both ZE and KZ. We tried to diversify the gameplay with new ideas. We have completely abandoned the corridor defend. We have provided an open world without massive zombie teleports, and also added new movement mechanics
_____________________________________
